name: Unbiased Estimation of Transmitted Lighting
definition: A path tracing technique to estimate transmitted caustics by finding direct paths between a receptor point and a light source using Fermat's principle, handling both refractive interfaces and heterogeneous media.
summary: Unbiased Estimation of Transmitted Lighting estimates transmitted caustics by finding direct light paths between a receptor and a light source using Fermat's principle, handling refractive interfaces and heterogeneous media.
